operation.description: This API retrieves all warehouse information associated with the seller. Warehouse information includes name, status, address, and other details.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description: Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

warehouses.description: All the warehouses associated with the seller.

address_line1.description:
The first line of the warehouse address, like street name and street number.
Note: 
- For Brazilian market, this represents the neighborhood or district.
- For the JP market, this represents the district (Chome), block (Banchi), building number (Go).

address_line2.description:
The second line of the warehouse address, like flat, apartment, or suit.
Note: For the Brazilian market, this represents the street name.

address_line3.description:
This represents the street number. If it's `s/n`, it means null.
Note: Available only in the Brazilian market.

address_line4.description:
This represents supplement information, like flat, apartment, or suit (optional).
Note: Available only in the Brazilian market.

first_name.description:
Kanji first name
Applicable only for the JP market.

first_name_local_script.description:
Hiragana or Katakana first name
Applicable only for the JP market.

full_address.description: The combined warehouse address, including the street address and other address information such as apartment number, building, floor..etc (optional)

geolocation.description: The geographical location of the address.

last_name.description:
Kanji last name
Applicable only for the JP market.

last_name_local_script.description:
Hiragana or Katakana last name
Applicable only for the JP market.

postal_code.description: Warehouse address postal code (also known as zip code)

effect_status.description:
Possible values:
- ENABLED: All products in stock are available for sale.
- DISABLED: All products in stock are unavailable for sale. 
- RESTRICTED: The warehouse is either on "holiday mode" or "order limit mode." All products in stock are unavailable for sale.
-Holiday mode: When the seller cannot fulfill an order from a warehouse, the seller can turn on holiday mode for the warehouse in seller center. 
- Order limit mode: When the seller violates TikTok Shop policies, TikTok Shop will limit the order volume that can be fulfilled by a warehouse.

entity_id.description: The warehouse entity ID, used to associate physical information of a warehouse, different warehouses may be associated with the same entity.

id.description: The warehouse ID, a unique and immutable primary key, used for all warehouse logistics.

is_default.description: The default warehouse.  If a product is listed with no designated warehouse, the default warehouse will be used.

name.description: Warehouse name. This name is not unique across the TikTok Shop system.

sub_type.description:
Possible values:
- DOMESTIC_WAREHOUSE: The warehouse is in the same country as the target market and the seller.
- CB_OVERSEA_WAREHOUSE: For cross-border sellers, a local warehouse in the target market. 
- CB_DIRECT_SHIPPING_WAREHOUSE: For cross-border sellers, a warehouse in the seller's base country, e.g., Mainland China or Hong Kong.

type.description:
Possible values:
- SALES_WAREHOUSE: Warehouse for shipping products.  
- RETURN_WAREHOUSE: Warehouse for receiving returned products. 
You can have the same warehouse for both shipping and receiving returns, but they will have different warehouse IDs with the same address.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
